seller.guideIntro: Ubufasha bugufi bwo kugurisha ku meza yo kwishyuriraho: kwandika igurisha, gushaka igicuruzwa, kwakira amafaranga, gucapa inyemezabwishyu, no kwakira ibicuruzwa igihe umukiriya abisubije.
seller.closingNote: Buri gurisha wanditse riringanizwa mu ibaruramari. Ubu bufasha bukubiyemo imashini yo kwishyuriraho; ibyerekeye ibitabo ni ibya JENESIS Accounting & Business.

seller_interface.title: Ipaji y'umucuruzi
seller_interface.purpose: Kugurisha ku meza yo kwishyuriraho. Icyo ukeneye cyose mu kugurisha kiri kuri iyi paji, nta kindi kiguhagarara imbere.
seller_interface.where: JENESIS Seller (porogaramu itukura). Ifungura ipaji yo kugurisha.
steps: Reba inkingi ibumoso: yerekana aho ushobora kujya — Imbonerahamwe, Igurisha, Abakiriya, Ububiko, Ubufasha.
Umurongo wo hejuru werekana sosiyete ukoreramo, itariki y'uyu munsi, imashini ibara, Messenger, ururimi n'izina ryawe.
Hagati ya paji niho igurisha ryubakwa: umukiriya, hanyuma ibicuruzwa.
seller_interface.expected: Ubona imibare y'uyu munsi kandi ushobora gutangira kugurisha utafunguye indi paji.
notes: Ibara rya porogaramu ni umutuku. Niba umurongo uri ubururu, uri muri JENESIS Accounting & Business, ifite ibitabo by'ibaruramari atari imashini yo kwishyuriraho.
Izina ryawe riri hejuru iburyo. Igurisha ryose wanditse rijyanishwa n'iryo zina.

seller_sales.title: Kwandika igurisha
seller_sales.purpose: Kwandika ibyo umukiriya aguze. Igurisha, ububiko n'ibaruramari bivugururwa icyarimwe, bityo ntiwandika ikintu kimwe kabiri.
steps: Hitamo umukiriya, cyangwa usige ari umukiriya w'inzira niba atafite konti.
Ongeraho buri kintu: hitamo igicuruzwa, hanyuma ingano. Ingano zishobora kuba ibice — nusu kilo yandikwa 0.5.
Reba igiciro n'igiteranyo hasi.
Hitamo uko umukiriya yishyura: amafaranga mu ntoki, banki, cyangwa Mobile Money.
Kanda Bika (cyangwa andike ubwishyu) kugira ngo urangize.
seller_sales.expected: Igurisha rirabitswe, ububiko bwa buri kintu buragabanuka n'ingano nyayo yaguzwe, kandi inyandiko y'ibaruramari ikorwa. Kugurisha 1.25 kg bikura 1.25 kg mu bubiko — atari kilo imwe, kandi atari ebyiri.
notes: Ntushobora kugurisha ibirenze ibyo ufite. Niba porogaramu yanga igurisha, banza urebe ingano y'ububiko bw'icyo kintu.
Igurisha ryandikwa ako kanya uribikishije. Kugira ngo ukosore igurisha ryabitswe, andika isubizwa aho kurihindura.

seller_search.title: Gushaka igicuruzwa
seller_search.purpose: Kubona vuba icyo umukiriya asaba, ukoresheje izina cyangwa kode iriho.
seller_search.where: Agasanduku k'igicuruzwa ku igurisha, cyangwa Ububiko → Ibicuruzwa.
steps: Andika igice cy'izina, cyangwa kode yose, mu gasanduku k'igicuruzwa.
Urutonde ruragabanuka uko wandika; hitamo icyo ushaka.
Niba nta kintu kigaragara, igicuruzwa gishobora kuba kitarakorwa — umuyobozi yongeramo ibicuruzwa muri JENESIS Accounting & Business.
seller_search.expected: Igicuruzwa cyongerwa ku igurisha hamwe n'igiciro cyacyo n'ububiko busigaye.
notes: Gushaka bireba izina na kode, bityo kode ngufi akenshi irihuta iyo hari abantu benshi.
Ububiko busigaye bwerekanwa iruhande rw'igicuruzwa, ushobora gusubiza umukiriya udasohotse ku igurisha.

seller_customers.title: Abakiriya
seller_customers.purpose: Kugurisha ku ideni ku mukiriya uzi, no kureba ibyo arimo.
steps: Fungura Abakiriya kugira ngo urebe buri mukiriya n'ibyo arimo.
Kugira ngo wongereho umwe, kanda Umukiriya mushya maze wuzuze izina na nimero ya telefoni niba uyifite.
Hitamo umukiriya ku igurisha iyo aguze ku ideni aho kwishyura ako kanya.
seller_customers.expected: Kugurisha ku ideni byongera ibyo uwo mukiriya arimo. Iyo yishyuye nyuma, ibyo arimo biragabanuka.
notes: Umukiriya wishyura buri gihe ntabwo akeneye konti: siga igurisha ku mukiriya w'inzira.
Ushobora kureba ibyo umukiriya arimo, ari umuyobozi gusa ushobora guhanagura ideni.

seller_receipts.title: Inyemezabwishyu no kwakira amafaranga
seller_receipts.purpose: Kwakira amafaranga no guha umukiriya inyemezabwishyu ihuye n'ibyo yaguze.
seller_receipts.where: Igice cy'ubwishyu ku igurisha, na Igurisha → urutonde rw'igurisha.
steps: Hitamo uko umukiriya yishyura: amafaranga mu ntoki, banki, cyangwa Mobile Money.
Andika ibyo yaguhaye; ibyo usubiza abarirwa.
Bika igurisha, hanyuma capa inyemezabwishyu.
Kugira ngo usubize amafaranga, andika isubizwa: ni ubwishyu bufite ingano ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa, kandi amafaranga ava mu isanduku, muri banki cyangwa kuri konti ya Mobile Money wahisemo.
seller_receipts.expected: Amafaranga yandikwa kuri konti wahisemo, kandi ibyo umukiriya arimo biragabanuka n'ibyo yishyuye.
notes: Isubizwa ryandikwa rifite ingano ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa. Rikura amafaranga kuri konti, kandi inyemezabwishyu n'ibaruramari byerekana ko ari isubizwa.
Ntushobora gusubiza ibirenze ibyo umukiriya yishyuye kuri iryo gurisha.

seller_printing.title: Gucapa inyemezabwishyu
seller_printing.purpose: Gucapira umukiriya inyemezabwishyu ku icapa iri ku meza yo kwishyuriraho, mu buryo iduka ryawe rikeneye.
seller_printing.where: Buto Capa inyemezabwishyu ku igurisha cyangwa ku nyemezabuguzi yabitswe, na JENESIS Settings & Access Point → Gucapa kugira ngo uyishyireho.
steps: Ku igurisha, kanda Capa inyemezabwishyu. Inyemezabwishyu ijya ku icapa wahisemo.

Kugira ngo uhindure uko isa, fungura JENESIS Settings & Access Point, jya mu Gucapa, hanyuma uhitemo icapa, impapuro (58 mm, 80 mm, A4 cyangwa ubugari wihitiyemo), ingano y'inyandiko n'ibizagaragaraho.
Kanda Erekana igerageza kugira ngo urebe inyemezabwishyu nk'uko izacapwa, na Capa inyemezabwishyu yo kugerageza kugira ngo urebe icapa mbere y'uko umukiriya ategereza.
Kanda Bika iyi miterere iyo bikunejeje.
seller_printing.expected: Inyemezabwishyu icapa ku rupapuro wahisemo, ifite ibisobanuro wahisemo, kandi bikomeza bityo ubutaha.
notes: Imiterere ubitse ni iya JENESIS Seller kuri iyi mudasobwa. Kubika ntibihindura icapa rya JENESIS Accounting & Business.
Imibare y'ibice icapa nk'uko uyanditse — 1.25 iguma 1.25 — kandi igicuruzwa cyasubijwe cyerekana akamenyetso k'ubusa n'ijambo « byasubijwe ».
Gucapa inyemezabwishyu ntibihindura igurisha. Kuyicapa kabiri bita impapuro ebyiri, atari igurisha kabiri.

seller_returns.title: Ibyasubijwe n'amasubizwa
seller_returns.purpose: Gusubiza ibicuruzwa no gusubiza amafaranga, kugira ngo ububiko n'isanduku byombi bivuge ukuri.
seller_returns.where: Igurisha rishya, cyangwa inyemezabwishyu yo gusubiza ku nyemezabuguzi yabitswe.
steps: Kugira ngo wakire ibicuruzwa ku meza yo kwishyuriraho, andika igicuruzwa gifite ingano ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa — kuri nusu kilo yasubijwe, andika -0.5.
Kugira ngo usubize inyemezabuguzi yose, fungura igurisha maze ukore inyemezabwishyu yo gusubiza. Vuga niba ibicuruzwa bisubira mu bubiko.
Kugira ngo usubize amafaranga, andika ubwishyu bufite ingano ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa.
seller_returns.expected: Ibicuruzwa byasubijwe bisubira mu bubiko, kandi amafaranga usubiza ava mu isanduku, muri banki cyangwa kuri konti ya Mobile Money.
notes: Inyemezabwishyu yo gusubiza ni bwo buryo bwiza bwo kwakira ibicuruzwa ku nyemezabuguzi: yandika impamvu, kandi ishobora gusubiza ububiko icyarimwe.
Umurongo ufite akamenyetso k'ubusa ku igurisha ni ikosora ryihuse ku meza yo kwishyuriraho. Byombi birakora; inyemezabwishyu yo gusubiza ni yo isiga ibisobanuro byuzuye.
Inyemezabwishyu irimo ibyasubijwe irabyerekana, kugira ngo umukiriya abone ko ibicuruzwa byasubijwe aho kuba ingano ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa yaguzwe.

seller_stock.title: Kureba ibiri mu bubiko
seller_stock.purpose: Gusubiza ikibazo cy'umukiriya, cyangwa kureba mbere yo kumusezeranya, udasohotse ku meza yo kwishyuriraho.
seller_stock.where: Ububiko → Ibicuruzwa, n'umubare w'ububiko werekanwa iruhande rwa buri gicuruzwa ku igurisha.
steps: Fungura Ububiko → Ibicuruzwa kugira ngo urebe ibyo ufite kuri buri kintu.
Ku igurisha, ububiko busigaye bwerekanwa iruhande rw'igicuruzwa igihe ugihisemo.
Koresha agasanduku ko gushaka kugira ngo ubone igicuruzwa kimwe vuba.
seller_stock.expected: Ubona ingano ufite y'ikintu mbere yo kukigurisha.
notes: Umubare w'ububiko ni ibyasigaye nyuma y'ibyaguzwe byose: ni ukuri muri uyu mwanya.
Ibice birakomeza: niba ufite 2.5 kg, ureba 2.5 atari 2.
Umuyobozi gusa ashobora guhindura ibyo ufite; kubara ububiko ni bwo buryo bwiza bwo kubikosora.

seller_shortcuts.title: Inzira ngufi za clavier
seller_shortcuts.purpose: Gukora vuba ku meza yo kwishyuriraho udashaka imbeba.
seller_shortcuts.where: Ahantu hose muri JENESIS Seller. Kanda F1 kugira ngo ubone urutonde rwose.
steps: F1 — fungura ubu bufasha.
F2 — tangira igurisha rishya.
Ctrl+Maj+K — imashini ibara.
Ctrl+Maj+C — abakiriya.
Alt+T — hindura imiterere y'umucyo cyangwa umwijima.
Alt+L — hindura ururimi.
notes: Inzira ngufi ntizikora igihe urimo wandika: kwandika izina ry'igicuruzwa ntibizatera iyo ari yo yose ku bw'impanuka.
Inzira ngufi ikora gusa niba ufite uburenganzira bwo gukora icyo ikora.

seller_troubleshooting.title: Iyo ikintu kitagenze neza
seller_troubleshooting.purpose: Gukemura ibibazo bike bibaho ku meza yo kwishyuriraho, cyangwa kumenya uwo bahamagara.
steps: « Sinshobora kugurisha iki kintu » — nta cyo ugifite, cyangwa ufite gito ugerageza kugurisha. Reba ingano y'ububiko.
« Icapa nta cyo ryakoze » — reba ko ryakongerewe, rifite impapuro kandi ridafite ikibazo. Capa inyemezabwishyu yo kugerageza uvuye mu Imiterere → Gucapa kugira ngo urebe.
« Inyemezabwishyu iraciwe » — ingano y'urupapuro ishobora kuba itari yo ku icapa ryawe. Fungura Imiterere → Gucapa uhitemo 58 mm cyangwa 80 mm bihuye n'umuzingo.
« Nanditse umubare utari wo » — ntuhindure igurisha ryabitswe. Andika isubizwa cyangwa isubizwa ry'amafaranga kugira ngo ibaruramari rigume rifite amateka nyayo.
« Nafunzwe » — tegereza iminota mike wongere ugerageze, cyangwa usabe umuyobozi kuguhindurira ijambo ry'ibanga.
seller_troubleshooting.expected: Uzi icyo ubutumwa busobanura n'icyo gukora nyuma.
notes: Nta cyo ukora ku meza yo kwishyuriraho gishobora gutakaza ibaruramari: ikosora ryandikwa nk'ikosora, ntirihanagurwa na rimwe.
Niba porogaramu itangira na gato, cyangwa ipaji iri ubusa, ako ni akazi ka JENESIS Network & Maintenance.

credits.title: Uwakoze JENESIS
credits.where: Iki gice kiri ku musozo wa buri gafasha ka JENESIS.
steps: JENESIS yakozwe kandi itezwa imbere na KAYIGANWA JACQUES.
credits.expected: Uzi uwo porogaramu ari we n'uyiteza imbere.
notes: Ubu bufasha busobanura porogaramu uko iri. Busobanura gusa ibikorwa bihari muri JENESIS.

admin.guideTitle: Uburyo bwo gukoresha JENESIS Accounting & Business
admin.guideIntro: Ubufasha bugufi bwo gucunga ibitabo: kwandika inyandiko, kwandika kugura, gukora raporo, no kwemeza ibyo buri muntu yemerewe gukora.
admin.closingNote: Buri nyandiko wemeje iringanizwa mbere yo kwemerwa, kugira ngo raporo zihorana n'ibitabo.

admin_dashboard.title: Imbonerahamwe
admin_dashboard.purpose: Kureba uko ubucuruzi bumeze mu kanya gato mbere yo kwinjira mu bisobanuro.
admin_dashboard.where: Imbonerahamwe mu nkingi ibumoso ya JENESIS Accounting & Business (porogaramu y'ubururu).
steps: Fungura Imbonerahamwe kugira ngo urebe igurisha, kugura, ibyo abakiriya barimo, ibyo urimo abatanga ibicuruzwa, n'inyungu kugeza ubu.
Koresha igihe cyo hejuru kugira ngo urebe ikindi gihe.
Fungura umubare uwo ari wo wose kugira ngo ujye ku nyandiko ziwugize.
admin_dashboard.expected: Ubona uko ubucuruzi bumeze kandi ushobora kujya ku kintu icyo ari cyo cyose gisa nabi.
notes: Buri mubare ubarwa uvuye ku nyandiko z'ibaruramari, bityo uhuza na raporo ku giceri.
Imbonerahamwe yerekana sosiyete ukoreramo. Hindura sosiyete hejuru ibumoso niba ucunga izirenze imwe.

admin_accounting.title: Ibikorwa by'ibaruramari
admin_accounting.purpose: Kwandika inyandiko mu bitabo: ibitabo, ibyongerwa n'ibikosora bituma ibisigaye birungi.
steps: Fungura urutonde rw'amakonti kugira ngo urebe buri konti n'ibyo isigaranye.
Kugira ngo wandike inyandiko ukoresheje intoki, fungura inyandiko nshya y'igitabo: hitamo amakonti, hanyuma ibyinjira n'ibisohoka.
Reba ko ibyinjira n'ibisohoka bingana mbere yo kwemeza — porogaramu yanga inyandiko idahwanye.
Kugira ngo ugabanye uruhande aho kurwongera, andika umubare ufite akamenyetso k'ubusa; rwandikwa ku ruhande rundi, icyo ni cyo ikosora.
admin_accounting.expected: Inyandiko iremezwa, kandi imizania na raporo birayifata ako kanya.
notes: Inyandiko idahwanye ntishobora kwemezwa. Iyo tegeko ni ryo rituma ibitabo biba ukuri.
Imibare ishobora kuba iy'ibice, kandi ikosora ni umubare ufite akamenyetso k'ubusa ku ruhande rugabanywa.
Inyandiko ziva ku igurisha, ku kugura cyangwa ku bwishyu nazo zigaragara hano; si ibitabo bitandukanye.

admin_purchases.title: Kugura n'inyemezabuguzi z'abatanga ibicuruzwa
admin_purchases.purpose: Kwandika ibyo ugura n'ibyo urimo, no kugumisha ububiko n'ibaruramari ku ntambwe imwe.
steps: Andika inyemezabuguzi y'uwaguhaye ibicuruzwa: uwabitanze, itariki, hanyuma ibyo waguze n'igiciro cyabyo.
Niba ibicuruzwa byageze, byakire kugira ngo ububiko buzamuke.
Andika ubwishyu igihe wishyuye uwaguhaye ibicuruzwa; ibyo umurimo biragabanuka.
Kugira ngo usubize ibicuruzwa, kora isubizwa ryo kugura ku nyemezabuguzi.
admin_purchases.expected: Kugura, ububiko n'ibyo urimo biba bigezweho, kandi igihombo kiri mu ibaruramari.
notes: Ingano zishobora kuba iy'ibice: kugura 2.5 kg byandikwa 2.5.
Kugira ngo ukosore inyemezabuguzi wanditse, kora isubizwa cyangwa inyemezabwishyu yo gusubiza aho guhindura iy'umwimerere.
Ingano yakiriwe ntishobora kuba ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa; koresha isubizwa ryo kugura, ryandika impamvu.

admin_parties.title: Abakiriya n'abatanga ibicuruzwa
admin_parties.purpose: Kugumana abantu ukorana nabo, no kumenya neza ibyo buri wese arimo.
admin_parties.where: Abakiriya n'Abatanga ibicuruzwa mu nkingi ibumoso.
steps: Fungura Abakiriya kugira ngo urebe buri mukiriya n'ibyo arimo; fungura Abatanga ibicuruzwa ku byo urimo.
Ongeraho cyangwa uhindure dosiye ukoresheje izina, uburyo bwo kubabona na nimero y'umusoro niba uyifite.
Capa imenyekanisha kuri umwe muri bo kugira ngo werekane ibisigaye.
admin_parties.expected: Ibisigaye bihuza n'ibaruramari, kuko byombi biva ku nyandiko zimwe.
notes: Ibisigaye birazamuka iyo ugurishije cyangwa uguze ku ideni, kandi biragabanuka iyo ubwishyu bwanditswe.
Guhanagura umukiriya ufite amateka ntibyemewe; dosiye irafungwa aho, kugira ngo ibaruramari rigume ryuzuye.

admin_taxes.title: Imisoro na TVA
admin_taxes.purpose: Kwishyuza umusoro ukwiye, no kuwutanga neza.
admin_taxes.where: Imiterere → Imisoro, n'inkingi y'umusoro ku igurisha cyangwa ku kugura.
steps: Shyiraho buri gipimo cy'umusoro rimwe: izina n'ijanisha.
Igipimo gishyirwa ku murongo iyo wanditse igurisha cyangwa kugura.
Ibiciro bishobora kuba birimo umusoro cyangwa bitawurimo; imiterere ya sosiyete ni yo ibigena, ishyirwa mu Imiterere → Sosiyete.
Koresha raporo ya TVA kugira ngo urebe ibyo wakusanyije n'ibyo wishyuye.
admin_taxes.expected: Umusoro wishyuzwa kuri buri murongo ku gipimo washyizeho, kandi raporo ya TVA ihuza n'ibaruramari.
notes: Igipimo kitagikoreshwa kirahagarikwa aho guhanagurwa, kugira ngo inyandiko za kera zigume ari ukuri.
Igipimo kibikwa kuri buri murongo igihe cyo kugurisha: guhindura igipimo nyuma ntibisubika amateka.

admin_reports.title: Raporo z'imari
admin_reports.purpose: Gukora imibare ubucuruzi n'ubuyobozi bw'imisoro bakeneye.
steps: Hitamo raporo: Igitabo rusange, Inyandiko z'igitabo, Imizania, Inyungu n'igihombo, Bilan, Imigendekere y'amafaranga, Imyenda y'abakiriya, Imyenda y'abatanga ibicuruzwa, TVA, cyangwa Igiciro cy'ububiko.
Shyiraho igihe ushaka.
Yisomere kuri ecran, uyicape, cyangwa uyohereze hanze.
admin_reports.expected: Raporo ihuza n'ibaruramari, kuko ikorwa iva ku nyandiko zimwe.
notes: Buri raporo ikemura imibare ifite akamenyetso k'ubusa n'iy'ibice, bityo isubizwa cyangwa ingano y'igice cyerekana uko cyanditswe.
Imizania na Bilan bigomba guhwana. Niba bitari ko biri, hari inyandiko yo gushaka, atari raporo yo gushidikanya.

admin_records.title: Inyandiko z'ibaruramari
admin_records.purpose: Kongera kubona inyandiko iyo ari yo yose, no kumenya uwayikoze n'igihe.
admin_records.where: Ibaruramari → urutonde rw'inyandiko, na Imiterere → Inyandiko y'igenzura.
steps: Shakisha mu rutonde rw'inyandiko ukoresheje itariki, konti, cyangwa numero y'iranga inyandiko.
Fungura inyandiko kugira ngo urebe impande zombi zayo n'inyandiko yayikoze.
Inyandiko y'igenzura yerekana ukoze iki n'igihe.
admin_records.expected: Umubare uwo ari wo wose muri raporo iyo ari yo yose ushobora gukurikiranwa kugeza ku nyandiko yawukoze.
notes: Inyandiko ntizihanagurwa na rimwe. Ikosa rikosorwa n'inyandiko ihindura, bityo amateka aguma yuzuye.
Buri nyandiko yandika izina ry'uwakoresheje wayemeje.

admin_permissions.title: Abakoresha, inshingano n'uburenganzira
admin_permissions.purpose: Kureka buri muntu agakora akazi ke n'ibindi atarenza, no kumenya uwakoze iki.
admin_permissions.where: Imiterere → Abakoresha. Umuyobozi gusa ashobora kuyifungura.
steps: Ongeraho ukoresha afite izina n'ijambo ry'ibanga ry'agateganyo; arihindura ubwa mbere yinjiye.
Muhe inshingano — Umuyobozi, Umubaramari, Igurisha, Kugura cyangwa Ububiko — igena ibyo abona n'ibyo ashobora gukora.
Hagarika ukoresha ugiye aho kumuhanagura.
admin_permissions.expected: Buri muntu abona amapaji akazi ke gakeneye, kandi buri gikorwa cyandikwa ku izina rye.
notes: Uburenganzira bushyirwa mu bikorwa na porogaramu atari gusa na menu: guhisha buto si bwo burinzi bwonyine.
Tanga inshingano ntoya ishoboka ituma umuntu akora akazi ke.

admin_functions.title: Imirimo y'umuyobozi
admin_functions.purpose: Imirimo umuyobozi gusa akora: gushyiraho sosiyete, no kurinda amakuru.
admin_functions.where: JENESIS Settings & Access Point, na Imiterere muri JENESIS Accounting & Business.
steps: Shyiraho sosiyete: izina, aderesi, nimero y'umusoro n'ifaranga.
Kora ububiko bw'amakuru (backup) mbere yo gukora ikintu gishobora guteza akaga, kandi ubike dosiye ahandi hatari kuri iyi mudasobwa.
Subiza amakuru uvuye mu bubiko gusa igihe ubishaka, wumva ko asimbura ayari ahari.
Ongeraho abakoresha kandi wemeze ibyo buri wese ashobora gukora.
admin_functions.expected: Sosiyete ishyizweho neza kandi hari kopi y'amakuru yo kugarukaho.
notes: Ububiko bw'amakuru ni ububiko gusa niba warebye ko busubiza. Bwipime mbere yo kubukenera.
Guhindura uburenganzira bw'ukoresha bihagarika umwanya arimo: banza umubwire.

admin_shortcuts.title: Inzira ngufi za clavier
admin_shortcuts.where: Ahantu hose muri JENESIS Accounting & Business. Kanda F1 kugira ngo ubone urutonde rwose.
steps: F1 — fungura ubu bufasha.
Ctrl+Maj+L — igitabo rusange.
Ctrl+Maj+T — kohereza.
Ctrl+Maj+K — imashini ibara.
Ctrl+Maj+M — Messenger.
Alt+T — hindura imiterere y'umucyo cyangwa umwijima.
Alt+L — hindura ururimi.
notes: Inzira ngufi ntizikora igihe urimo wandika.
Inzira ngufi ikora gusa niba inshingano zawe zemera icyo ikora.

credits.title: Uwakoze JENESIS
credits.where: Iki gice kiri ku musozo wa buri gafasha ka JENESIS.
steps: JENESIS yakozwe kandi itezwa imbere na KAYIGANWA JACQUES.
credits.expected: Uzi uwo porogaramu ari we n'uyiteza imbere.
notes: Ubu bufasha busobanura porogaramu uko iri. Busobanura gusa ibikorwa bihari muri JENESIS.

maintenance.guideTitle: Uburyo bwo gukoresha JENESIS Network & Maintenance
maintenance.guideIntro: Ubufasha bugufi bwo kugumisha serivisi ya JENESIS ikora: imiterere ya réseau, guhuza andi mamudasobwa yo mu iduka, n'ibyo kureba iyo imwe muri yo itagera kuri JENESIS.
maintenance.closingNote: Ibyo iyi porogaramu ikora byose bireba serivisi na réseau. Ntihindura ibaruramari na rimwe.

maint_interface.title: Ipaji yo gufata neza
maint_interface.purpose: Kugumisha serivisi ya JENESIS ikora n'amamudasobwa yo kuri réseau avugana na yo.
steps: Fungura porogaramu kugira ngo urebe niba serivisi irimo gukora n'amamudasobwa ahujwe.
Ipaji yerekana imiterere ya serivisi, aderesi andi mamudasobwa akoresha, n'urutonde rw'amamudasobwa abonetse kuri réseau.
Koresha utubuto kugira ngo wongere utangize serivisi cyangwa wongere urebe réseau.
maint_interface.expected: Ubona mu kanya gato niba andi mamudasobwa ashobora kugera kuri JENESIS, kandi ugakora niba atabishobora.
notes: Iyi porogaramu nta mapaji y'ibaruramari, yo kugurisha, y'abakiriya cyangwa y'ibicuruzwa igira ku bushake. Yita kuri serivisi, atari ku bitabo.
Kongera gutangiza serivisi bihagarika gato abari gukoresha JENESIS ku yindi mudasobwa: bikore igihe iduka rituje.

maint_network.title: Imiterere ya réseau
maint_network.purpose: Gushyiraho aderesi n'umuryango andi mamudasobwa akoresha kugira ngo agere kuri JENESIS.
maint_network.where: Igice cya réseau muri JENESIS Network & Maintenance.
steps: Reba aderesi yerekanwe: ni aderesi y'iyi mudasobwa kuri réseau y'aho.
Umuryango ni numero JENESIS yumviraho. Andi mamudasobwa akeneye umwe.
Ongera utangize serivisi nyuma yo guhindura ikintu, kugira ngo bihinduke.
maint_network.expected: Serivisi yongera gutangira kuri aderesi n'umuryango washyizeho.
notes: Gusangira JENESIS n'andi mamudasobwa birahagaritswe kugeza ubikongeje. Nta kintu gisangirwa ku bw'impanuka.
Niba aderesi y'iyi mudasobwa ihindutse, andi mamudasobwa azakenera kuyoborwa ku nshya.

maint_connect.title: Guhuza amamudasobwa kuri réseau
maint_connect.purpose: Kureka andi mamudasobwa yo mu iduka agakoresha amakuru amwe ya JENESIS.
maint_connect.where: Urutonde rw'amamudasobwa muri JENESIS Network & Maintenance, n'imiterere yo guhuza ku yindi mudasobwa.
steps: Menya neza ko buri mudasobwa iri kuri réseau imwe y'aho.
Ku yindi mudasobwa, fungura JENESIS uyiyobore kuri aderesi n'umuryango werekanwe hano.
Reba niba mudasobwa igaragara mu rutonde nk'igerwaho.
maint_connect.expected: Indi mudasobwa ifungura JENESIS igakora ku makuru amwe n'aya.
notes: Amamudasobwa yombi agomba kuba kuri réseau imwe. Mudasobwa iri ku yindi réseau, cyangwa yazimye, ntizaboneka.
Gushaka amamudasobwa kuri réseau birahagaritswe ku ntangiriro ku bw'ibanga; bikongeje hano igihe ubikeneye.

maint_manage.title: Gucunga uhuza
maint_manage.purpose: Kureba uwo uhuye, no kugenza mudasobwa itagombye kuba ihujwe.
maint_manage.where: Urutonde rw'amamudasobwa muri JENESIS Network & Maintenance.
steps: Urutonde rwerekana buri mudasobwa yabonetse, niba isubiza, kandi niba ihujwe ubu.
Kanda Ongera urebe kugira ngo wongere ushake.
Koresha amabwiriza yo guhuza kugira ngo wemere cyangwa wange mudasobwa.
maint_manage.expected: Uzi amamudasobwa ashobora kugera kuri JENESIS, kandi ushobora guhagarika imwe.
notes: Mudasobwa itigeze isuzumwa yerekana nk'itazwi kugeza uyishatse.
Igikoresho kiri kuri réseau kidakoresha JENESIS cyerekana ko ari cyo aho kugifatwa nk'imashini yo kwishyuriraho.

maint_troubleshooting.title: Gukemura ibibazo bya réseau
maint_troubleshooting.purpose: Kumenya impamvu mudasobwa itagera kuri JENESIS, no kuyikemura.
steps: « Indi mudasobwa ntishobora guhuza » — reba ko zombi ziri kuri réseau imwe, ko iyi mudasobwa yakongerewe, kandi ko umuryango utabujijwe na pare-feu.
« Mudasobwa yabuze ku rutonde » — ishobora kuba yazimye cyangwa iri mu bitotsi. Kanda Ongera urebe kugira ngo wongere ushake.
« Byakoraga ejo » — aderesi y'iyi mudasobwa ishobora kuba yarahindutse. Reba ko aderesi yerekanwe hano ihuye n'iyo indi mudasobwa ikoresha.
« JENESIS ntitangira » — ongera utangize serivisi uvuye kuri iyi paji urebe ubutumwa buvuga ko irimo gukora.
« Ipaji iri ubusa » — byerekane hamwe n'inyandiko yo gutangira, iyi porogaramu yandika kugira ngo itangira ryananiwe risobanurwe nyuma.
maint_troubleshooting.expected: Uzi impamvu imwe muri nkeya zisanzwe ari yo, n'icyo gukora.
notes: Icyo udashobora gukemura hano ni ikibazo cy'ibaruramari kuri JENESIS Accounting & Business, atari icya réseau.
Serivisi yandika inyandiko. Ni ho ha mbere ho kureba iyo ikintu kitangiye.

maint_settings.title: Imiterere
maint_settings.purpose: Imimerere mike ibarizwa kuri serivisi aho kuba iy'ibaruramari.
maint_settings.where: Igice cy'imiterere muri JENESIS Network & Maintenance.
steps: Fungura igice cy'imiterere kugira ngo urebe ibishobora guhinduka hano.
Hindura gusa ibyo ukeneye, kandi wongere utangize serivisi nyuma niba ubisabwe.
notes: Amakuru ya sosiyete, abakoresha, imisoro, amafaranga no gucapa bishyirwa muri JENESIS Settings & Access Point, atari hano.
Iyi porogaramu ntihindura ibaruramari na rimwe.

maint_shortcuts.title: Inzira ngufi za clavier
maint_shortcuts.where: Ahantu hose muri JENESIS Network & Maintenance. Kanda F1 kugira ngo ubone urutonde rwose.
steps: F1 — fungura ubu bufasha.
Alt+T — hindura imiterere y'umucyo cyangwa umwijima.
Alt+L — hindura ururimi.
notes: Inzira ngufi ntizikora igihe urimo wandika.
Hano hari inzira ngufi nke ku bushake: iyi porogaramu ifite amapaji make.

credits.title: Uwakoze JENESIS
credits.where: Iki gice kiri ku musozo wa buri gafasha ka JENESIS.
steps: JENESIS yakozwe kandi itezwa imbere na KAYIGANWA JACQUES.
credits.expected: Uzi uwo porogaramu ari we n'uyiteza imbere.
notes: Ubu bufasha busobanura porogaramu uko iri. Busobanura gusa ibikorwa bihari muri JENESIS.

settings.guideTitle: Uburyo bwo gukoresha JENESIS Settings & Access Point
settings.guideIntro: Ubufasha bugufi bwo gushyiraho JENESIS: ibyapa, imiterere y'inyemezabwishyu, ururimi, imiterere y'umucyo n'umwijima, n'amahitamo agena uko ubucuruzi bwandikwa.
settings.closingNote: Ibyo uhindura hano byose bireba imyitwarire ya JENESIS. Nta na kimwe gisiba ibyanditswe.

set_overview.title: Icyo Imiterere imariye
set_overview.purpose: Gushyiraho JENESIS: sosiyete, abakoresha, imisoro, amafaranga, ububiko bw'amakuru, imiterere n'icapa.
set_overview.where: JENESIS Settings & Access Point (porogaramu y'umuhondo), cyangwa Imiterere muri JENESIS Accounting & Business.
steps: Udupapuro two hejuru ni: Sosiyete, Abakoresha, Imisoro, Igenzura, Amafaranga, Ububiko, Imiterere n'Icapa.
Fungura igipapuro ushaka, hindura ibyo ukeneye, hanyuma ubike.
Udupapuro tumwe dusaba umuyobozi; niba utari we, ntidufunguka.
set_overview.expected: JENESIS ishyizweho uko ubucuruzi bwawe bukora.
notes: Imiterere ihindura imyitwarire ya porogaramu. Ntihindura ibaruramari ryanditswe.
Niba igipapuro kibuze, inshingano zawe ntizirimo. Saba umuyobozi.

set_printers.title: Ibyapa
set_printers.purpose: Guhitamo icapa rica iki, no kureba ko rikora mbere y'uko umukiriya ategereza.
steps: Fungura igipapuro Gucapa. Urutonde rwerekana ibyapa byose by'iyi mudasobwa, ibyinjijwe n'ibiri kuri réseau.
Hitamo icapa ushaka; kurisiga ku icapa ryo ku ntangiriro bikoresha iryo Windows yakoresha.
Kanda Capa inyemezabwishyu yo kugerageza kugira ngo urebe ko rikora kandi rihuye.
Kanda Bika iyi miterere.
set_printers.expected: Inyemezabwishyu zijya ku icapa wahisemo, kandi wabonye urupapuro rwo kugerageza rusohoka.
notes: Icapa ryazimye, ritagira impapuro cyangwa ryafashwe n'ikibazo cyerekanwa ku rutonde aho guhishwa, kugira ngo ubone ko rihari ari rititeguye.
Icapa wahisemo ryibukwa kuri iyi mudasobwa. Indi mudasobwa igumana icyo yahisemo.
Muri navigateur, hatari porogaramu ya JENESIS ya mudasobwa, icapa rinyura mu idirishya ry'icapa rya navigateur.

set_receipts.title: Imiterere y'inyemezabwishyu
set_receipts.purpose: Kwemeza uko inyemezabwishyu isa: urupapuro, inyandiko, n'amakuru agaragara.
set_receipts.where: Icapa, mu bice by'impapuro, imiterere n'ibirimo.
steps: Hitamo urupapuro: umuzingo wa 58 mm, umuzingo wa 80 mm, urupapuro rwa A4, cyangwa ubugari wihitiyemo niba uwanyu utandukanye.
Shyiraho inyandiko: ingano, ubwoko bw'inyuguti, inyuguti zijimye, intera hagati y'imirongo n'uturimbo tune.
Andika umutwe inyemezabwishyu ifite n'ubutumwa bwo hasi.

Tora amakuru ushaka: ikirango, izina ry'ubucuruzi, aderesi, telefoni, imeyili, nimero y'umusoro, numero y'inyandiko, itariki, umucuruzi, umukiriya, ibisobanuro by'ibicuruzwa, uko imisoro iteye, ibiteranyo, uburyo bwo kwishyura, ibiri hasi n'umurongo wo kugabanya.
Kanda Erekana igerageza kugira ngo uyibone nk'uko izacapwa, kandi niba ihagije ku rupapuro.
Kanda Bika iyi miterere.
set_receipts.expected: Inyemezabwishyu icapa uko wayiteguye, kandi igumaho.
notes: Iyi miterere ni iya porogaramu urimo. Kuyibika muri JENESIS Seller ntibihindura JENESIS Accounting & Business, no mu buryo bunyuranye.
Igerageza ni inyandiko nyayo yo gucapa ku ngayo nyayo: niba umurongo uciweyo, uzacibwa no ku rupapuro.
Imibare y'ibice n'ibyasubijwe bicapa neza: 1.25 iguma 1.25, kandi igicuruzwa cyasubijwe gifite akamenyetso k'ubusa n'ijambo « byasubijwe ».
Gucapa ntibihindura igurisha, ubwishyu cyangwa inyandiko. Bikora impapuro gusa.

set_languages.title: Ururimi
set_languages.purpose: Gukoresha JENESIS mu Cyongereza, mu Gifaransa cyangwa mu Kinyarwanda.
set_languages.where: Ihitamo ry'ururimi hejuru ya paji, cyangwa kanda Alt+L.
steps: Kanda ku rurimi hejuru ya paji, cyangwa kanda Alt+L kugira ngo unyure muri eshatu.
Hitamo English, Français cyangwa Kinyarwanda.
set_languages.expected: Interface yose ihindura ururimi icyarimwe, kandi icyo wahisemo kiribukwa.
notes: Ururimi ni urwawe: ntiruhindura ibyo abandi bakoresha babona ku mamudasobwa yabo.
Inyandiko zacapwe zisigara mu rurimi zacapiwemo.

set_theme.title: Imiterere y'umucyo n'umwijima
set_theme.purpose: Gukora mu rumuri rwinshi cyangwa mu cyumba cyijimye udananiwe amaso.
set_theme.where: Igenzura ry'imiterere hejuru ya paji, cyangwa kanda Alt+T.
steps: Kanda Alt+T, cyangwa ku igenzura ry'imiterere, kugira ngo unyure hagati y'umucyo, umwijima no gukurikira mudasobwa.
Gukurikira mudasobwa bivuga ko JENESIS ikurikiza imiterere Windows ikoresha.
set_theme.expected: Interface irahinduka ako kanya kandi icyo wahisemo kiribukwa.
notes: Buri porogaramu ya JENESIS yibuka imiterere yayo: imashini yo kwishyuriraho ishobora kuba umucyo mu gihe biro biri umwijima.
Amabara ya porogaramu enye ntahinduka: Seller ni umutuku, Maintenance icyatsi, Accounting ubururu na Settings umuhondo, mu mucyo no mu mwijima.

set_preferences.title: Ibyo ukunda
set_preferences.purpose: Amahitamo ari ayawe kandi atari ay'undi muntu.
set_preferences.where: Hejuru ya paji no mu gipapuro Imiterere.
steps: Ururimi, imiterere, ijambo ry'ibanga n'amakuru yawe ni ibyawe gusa.
Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga uvuye ku izina ryawe hejuru iburyo igihe porogaramu ibikubajije, cyangwa igihe ubishakiye.
set_preferences.expected: JENESISA irasa kandi isomwa uko ukunda, nta kugira uwo ihungabanya.
notes: Ururimi n'imiterere yawe biragukurikira, atari mudasobwa: imashini yo kwishyuriraho isangiwe iguma ari iyawe.
Imiterere imwe, nk'amakuru ya sosiyete n'imisoro, ni iya buri wese kandi isaba umuyobozi.

set_options.title: Amahitamo yo gushyiraho
set_options.purpose: Imimerere igena uko ubucuruzi bwose bwanzikwa.
set_options.where: Udupapuro Sosiyete, Imisoro, Amafaranga n'Ububiko bw'amakuru.
steps: Sosiyete — izina, aderesi, nimero y'umusoro, umwaka w'ibaruramari, ifaranga n'igiciro cy'ububiko.
Imisoro — ibipimo wishyuza kandi wishyura, kandi niba ibiciro birimo umusoro.
Amafaranga — amafaranga ukoreramo n'ibipimo byo guhana.
Ububiko bw'amakuru — gukora kopi y'amakuru no kuyasubiza.
set_options.expected: Igurisha, kugura na raporo byitwara uko ubucuruzi bwawe bubikeneye.
notes: Iyi mimerere igira buri weseho: umuyobozi ni we uyihindura.
Igipimo kitagikoreshwa kirahagarikwa aho guhanagurwa, kugira ngo inyandiko za kera zigume ari ukuri.

set_troubleshooting.title: Iyo imiterere idakora
set_troubleshooting.where: Ahantu hose muri JENESIS Settings & Access Point.
steps: « Sinshobora gufungura igipapuro » — bisaba umuyobozi. Saba umwe, cyangwa injira nk'umuyobozi.
« Icapa ryanjye ntiriri ku rutonde » — reba ko ryakongerewe kandi rishyizwe muri Windows. Kanda Ongera urebe kugira ngo wongere ushake.
« Inyemezabwishyu iraciwe » — ingano y'impapuro ntihuye n'umuzingo. Gerageza 58 mm cyangwa 80 mm, kandi urebe igerageza.
« Nabikishije imiterere ariko imashini yo kwishyuriraho iracapa nka mbere » — imiterere ni iya porogaramu wari urimo. Yongere uyishyire muri porogaramu ucapisha.
« Ururimi ntirwahindutse hose » — inyandiko icapwe isigara mu rurimi yacapiwemo.
notes: Nta kintu mu Imiterere gisiba ibaruramari. Ndetse no gusubiza amakuru ni igikorwa cyatekerejweho, gishingiye ku bubiko bw'amakuru.

credits.title: Uwakoze JENESIS
credits.where: Iki gice kiri ku musozo wa buri gafasha ka JENESIS.
steps: JENESIS yakozwe kandi itezwa imbere na KAYIGANWA JACQUES.
credits.expected: Uzi uwo porogaramu ari we n'uyiteza imbere.
notes: Ubu bufasha busobanura porogaramu uko iri. Busobanura gusa ibikorwa bihari muri JENESIS.
